description: Combat decision vocabulary (COMB_001 action set, POC-2 slice). Closed set: a decision outside it rejects to fallback_tool (AGT-A2). Spatial resolution is engine-owned — the model picks a STANCE, never a tile (TG-A4 / LLM-zero-space).

tools.name: strike
tools.description: Basic attack against one hostile target in the offered candidate list.

target.description: Entity id of the target. MUST be one of the candidates offered in the decision context (THR-A4: the engine offers, the model chooses — it cannot name anyone it was not offered).

tools.name: defend
tools.description: Defensive stance until the actor's next turn. The vocabulary fallback: commits on reject, timeout, or deadline expiry (AGT-A2).

tools.name: move
tools.description: Reposition. The engine resolves the destination tile from the stance via influence-map (TG-A4) — the model never emits coordinates.

tools.name: flee
tools.description: Attempt to leave the encounter through the nearest exit; the engine resolves success and path.
